# wrkgrd

> A verification gate for source trees. wrkgrd detects which language stacks a repository uses, runs each stack's build and tests, and reports only failures in compact, color-free output.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install and basic use
- [Getting started](docs/guides/001-getting-started.md): install, commands, flags, `wrkgrd.toml` toggles, exit codes
- [Rules reference](docs/guides/002-rules-reference.md): every stack and verification tool, generated from `wrkgrd rules --format json`
- [Features reference](docs/guides/003-features-reference.md): every capability and harness adapter, generated from `wrkgrd features --format json`

## Optional

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): changes per release
